title: Can You Jump Off the Boat on a Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Yes, on the Day Trip: once the engine is off at the swim stop, you jump where the skipper points and climb back by the ladder. No swimming on the Sunset Trip.
heroAlt: A guest jumping feet first off the side of a motor boat into deep blue sea
keywords: can you jump off the boat on a boat trip in Madeira
Fajã dos Padres jump from boat
is it safe to jump off a boat
how deep is the water off Madeira

images.prompt: Late morning in July, photographed from the bow of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, looking back along the boat's side while it sits still with the engine off. One adult in dark swim shorts, seen from behind and slightly from the side, small in the frame, is in mid-air just after pushing off the side, feet first, arms tucked in, half a metre above deep blue water. Beyond, the steep brown and green cliff above Fajã dos Padres and a thin line of pebble shore. Bright sun, true colours, small ripples on the water, no faces visible, no text.
images.alt: A guest jumping feet first off the side of a motor boat into deep blue sea

images.prompt: Close detail at the stern of a white motor boat at midday: a stainless steel ladder going down from the swim platform into deep blue water, a swimmer's two hands gripping the rails from the water, wet footprints on the white platform, drops of water catching the sun, no faces.
images.alt: A swimmer's hands on the stern ladder of a motor boat after a jump

images.prompt: From the deck of a motor boat off Madeira's south coast in the afternoon: in the foreground, slightly out of focus, the bare feet of a guest waiting at the edge of the deck; a few metres away a swimmer seen from behind swims clear of the landing spot through calm, deep blue water, cliffs far behind.
images.alt: A guest waiting at the edge of the deck while the last jumper swims clear
